big: Nifty Midcap Select is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

h: What is the Nifty Midcap Select?
lines: What does the Nifty Midcap Select track?
The Nifty Midcap Select index aims to track the performance of a portfolio of 25 liquid midcap stocks. It holds 25 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.

intro: NSE factsheet, 30 Sep 2026, as per the lesson. Past returns do not predict the future.
note: P/E is price relative to earnings. A higher P/E means investors pay more for each rupee of earnings.
